The independent document-search delegate timed out after 600 seconds without a result; the root fallback search was explicitly nonexhaustive.

tracks.title: Risk geometry and balanced two-factor gate
tracks.exact_claim: Unrestricted one-factor and full-rank two-factor selector separation already followed from existing project results and was classified as an application corollary. Under zero aggregate exposures and lambda_min(G) >= T/4, the balanced gate proved normalized selector distance rho <= sqrt(3). The general whole-core identity is diam_L1(core) = 4 max_S ||a(S)|| = 2 max_unit_u sum_i |u dot a_i|.
limits: The owner-size cap is unnecessary for the upper bound.
The spectral bound is sharp for the whole core, but sharpness for the two fairness selectors was not established; the core-extremal family has selector distance zero.
The zero-aggregate, common-norm, transferable-savings contract does not describe nonnegative regulatory charges or truthful withholding automatically.
The exact diameter formulation was treated as elementary geometry; historical priority remained uncleared.
tracks.status: Bounded yes/no mathematical gate completed and stopped; economic contract/measurement required before another abstract constant campaign.

tracks.title: Hypothetical Treasury pooling empirical gate
tracks.exact_claim: Both frozen numerical gates failed. Across 84 monthly estimates in 2019-2025, the two fairness selectors agreed to floating-point precision; largest savings reassignment was 2.61e-16 against a required 5 percent median. Aggregate standardized tail severity was 1.7786 times Gaussian ES, with descriptive 90 percent circular-block interval [1.4016, 2.1137], and VaR exceedance 4.72 percent versus nominal 2.5 percent. The available-quote diagnostic also failed both gates, with aggregate tail ratio 1.6965.
limits: The highly hedged book is hypothetical and fixed; this is not a theorem of selector agreement for all covariances or portfolios.
Zero-credit constraints were infeasible in 75 of 84 primary months; a 5-percent-of-savings credit cap restored feasibility only in this example.
Fairness/Euler median reassignment of 43.71 percent is descriptive disagreement, not fairness superiority, welfare or sponsor-cost evidence.
Owner splitting changes the accounting game and cannot rescue the failed fixed-owner primary.
The quote-interval sensitivity is explicitly post-outcome, and the temporal holdout is retrospective.
tracks.status: Closed the illustrative book without promotion to an empirical paper or pooling claim; do not retune a portfolio to make selectors disagree.
tracks.evidence_class: Frozen hypothetical empirical protocol, two completed Fable snapshot reviews, independent formulation/code replay, and disclosed post-outcome sensitivity.
remaining_work: Require a genuine decision owner, fixed mandates/exposures, current allocation rule, transfer authority and decision consequence before a new institutional comparison.
Any redesign needs an untouched or prospective evaluation set; already inspected outcomes remain exploratory.

tracks.title: 25 October mathematical reset and coverage-retention obstruction
tracks.exact_claim: The frontier sqrt(s/6) <= K3(s) <= K3OUT(s) <= 3s^2 is unchanged. Unconstrained objective-preserving one-layer replacement satisfies L/3 <= J(L) <= L, so a cheap replacement assertion alone restates the unknown bound up to rank. At fixed s=2, an exactly arity-three institution with 3m productive multirow actual owners has a feasible certificate L=5m/2, D=6m for which every coverage-retaining sum of global one-layer certificates costs Dprime/D >= m/2 - 1/4. An augmentation gives an optimal L=D=6m, zero-slack input with the same lower bound and only singleton coverage if desired.
limits: The underlying institution has true all-profile K=1; this is a proof-architecture obstruction, not an unrestricted funding lower bound.
Replacement budgets, slacks, comparison coalition labels and legal profiles may change, but the marked coverage rows remain coefficientwise.
A different optimal certificate is already one-layer; selection of another optimum is not excluded.
The optional upper witness m/2 + 1/12 concerns the base certificate and its objective, not the augmented array.
No exponent improvement, novelty clearance or human specialist certification resulted.
tracks.status: Bounded reset complete. Reject exact coverage-preserving layer repair, including the section-4 candidate of REFORMULATION_GUARD.txt. Main unrestricted problem remains open; no automatic long campaign.
tracks.evidence_class: Conventional all-m/all-real-profile proofs; exact Fraction corroboration at m=1,2,4,8,16,64; separate Fable base and optimal-augmentation reviews; root adjudication.
remaining_work: Any subsequent normalization must allow coverage weakening/removal/recombination or another optimum, and supply a constructive quantitative invariant.
Do not treat a generic cheap-replacement lemma as a new route.

tracks.title: Latest irreversible compensation gate
tracks.exact_claim: For two fixed pure owners with F(a,b)=min(a,b) on the same [0,2]^2 box, preserving efficient-price charges with irreversible nonnegative owner reserves has exact best factor 1 + 3L/4 on the stated L-step chain. The attempted full-box envelope is infinite at (2,2). Any finite-budget individually truthful rule above efficient prices must release at least max(0, W_L-(K-1)F_L) cumulative reserve along the witness, where W_L=3L(L+1)/(2(L+2)) and F_L=2(L+1)/(L+2).
limits: The obstruction is to irreversible owner reserves, not unrestricted full OUT.
On the same full box, y=(F,0) has optimal unrestricted factor 1, while y=(F,F) has optimal factor 2 under efficient-price domination and permits reserve reassignment.
Required release occurs on owners passive during individual restorations; payments need not be discontinuous.
The reviewer auxiliary estimate Vminus >= 3L/2 - 2(K-1) was rejected; the retained proof uses the correct exact expression.
Finite-chain optimum is not an all-profile extension; no general upper/lower bound or novelty claim improved.
tracks.status: STOP the irreversible compensation candidate. No new long campaign on an unspecified compensation inequality; prioritize specialist review of consolidated paper. AI realization remains HOLD.
tracks.evidence_class: Conventional arbitrary-L/full-box proof, Fraction replay at nine chain lengths, all chain full-OUT comparisons, 36-profile benchmark calibration, earlier four-owner CEA replay; focused Fable review and root rejection of reviewer overstatement.
remaining_work: Any future formula must explicitly release and reassign reserves while controlling every protected coalition sum.
No such general formula was obtained; do not resume the rejected candidate or laminar simplification.
Human correctness/priority assessment of the consolidated work remains the immediate recommendation.
